plan.title: Rejected Bids offered after RFQ bidding ends

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ event's summary page as required for prepared-state cases.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Navigate to the RFQ stage whose Settings menu is under test.
Assert that Rejected Bids is present and enabled in the RFQ Settings menu.
Click Rejected Bids to verify that its window opens.
Assert that the Rejected Bids window is open.
Cancel the window so no rejection change is committed.
Assert that cancelling closes the Rejected Bids window.
